latestVersion.changelog:
0xSCADA v1.0.1

- Added license terms acceptance to metadata.
- Expanded required binaries: now includes curl and git.
- Updated environment variable support to include SCADA_DIR, WEB3_RPC_URL, PRIVATE_KEY, FLUX_URL, and FLUX_AUTH_TOKEN for richer configuration and blockchain integration.
- Enhanced documentation with an architecture note, configuration guide, and environmental variable descriptions.
- Startup now validates that SCADA_DIR points to a valid 0xSCADA repository.
